title: .pspdx
description: What a PSP homebrew repository says about itself to PSPDX. The version, the date, the package and its size come from the latest release; the id from the repository; the icon, the picture, the film and the sound out of the EBOOT.

source.description: The project source URL. Version 1 supports HTTPS GitHub repository URLs.

summary.description: one line; the repository's description otherwise

category.description: what this one app is; the list shows the plural

license.description: an SPDX identifier; what GitHub reports otherwise

author.description: a name; the repository's owner otherwise

installdir.description: where the package goes on the Memory Stick: the directory in the zip that holds the EBOOT.PBP, with everything beside and below it, is copied here. In version 1 it is PSP/GAME/<folder>, and the folder is the name the XMB shows; it is not ., .. or .pspdx-stage in any case, where the client stages an install; a later version may allow other places on the stick.
